mapper.select: WITH date_info AS ( -- 학생의 과정 시작일과 '현재 시점의 기준일' 설정 SELECT a.account_seq, c.cur_seq, c.cur_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, c.end_date) as reference_date FROM lms.tb_account a JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.account_seq = #{accountSeq} ), calendar AS ( -- 시작일부터 기준일까지의 날짜 리스트 생성 및 토/일 제외 SELECT di.account_seq, COUNT(d.day)::int as total_working_days FROM date_info di CROSS JOIN generate_series(di.start_date, di.reference_date, '1 day'::interval) as d(day) WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.day) NOT IN (0, 6) -- 0:일요일, 6:토요일 제외 /* 여기에 공휴일 테이블이 있다면 추가 제외 로직 삽입 가능 */ -- AND d.day::date NOT IN (SELECT holiday_date FROM lms.tb_holiday) GROUP BY di.account_seq ) SELECT di.account_seq, a.account_name, di.cur_name, TO_CHAR(di.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDate, TO_CHAR(di.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDate, cal.total_working_days, -- 각 상태별 카운트 (OFFICIAL 공결은 계산에서 제외하므로 카운트하지 않거나 무시) COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END)::int as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 END)::int as lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'OUTING' THEN 1 END)::int as outingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN att.status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 END)::int as earlyCount FROM date_info di JOIN lms.tb_account a ON di.account_seq = a.account_seq JOIN calendar cal ON di.account_seq = cal.account_seq LEFT JOIN lms.tb_attendance att ON di.account_seq = att.account_seq AND att.attendance_date BETWEEN di.start_date AND di.reference_date GROUP BY di.account_seq, a.account_name, di.cur_name, di.start_date, di.end_date, cal.total_working_days
